function shift203() { global $argument, $owner; $argument = new New203; $owner = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return null; }
class Old203 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } }
class New203 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }

class Derived203 extends Base203 {}
